632.title: Business switcher, the acting banner, entering a business from the platform table and the owner's access list
humanItems: Dandan, as the platform admin, taps "כניסה לעסק" on a test business in the platform table: the app reloads, the banner names that business, the lists show that business's products; "חזרה לעסק שלי" brings his own business back.

Dandan gives a test user access from the platform table, signs in as that user, switches into the business from the header, then as the owner removes the access in Settings: the consultant's next tap lands him in his own business with the notice.
The banner reads clearly on a phone and does not cover the page's own controls.
